title: AW27 Toddler Boys' Knit Fabric Direction
summary: Kidswear knits: organic fleece, merino, brushed cotton and wool blends.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-fair forecast. The AW27 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime Paris) take place in January 2027. This report applies the 2026 adult yarn, fabric and leather fair evidence and the AW26 kidswear fair record to kidswear, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Woolmark presented merino wool as "the technical fibre" for AW27 sourcing at Pitti Filati<sup>[1]</sup>
- At Playtime Paris in January 2026 (AW26 collections), CSR was "no longer a peripheral narrative": Minimalisma uses silk, merino, organic cotton and linen; MarMar Copenhagen uses Tencel modal and organic cotton for clothes that "last"; Gray Label sells a permanent unisex range and runs a pre-loved take-back<sup>[2]</sup>
- Brushed woollens, fur effects, mosses and wool sponges add touch; tapestries, jacquards and nomadic influences form the pattern repertoire<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Fabric by fabric
sections.body:
| Knit | Uses |
|---|---|
| Organic fleece | Sweatshirts |
| Merino | Base layers |
| Wool blend | Crews |

design_implications:
- Machine-washable wool; pilling tests.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Merino and organic fleece support price.
